# NEW 2026-11-23 v18.5 Module 18.5-C: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_feu_kernel_yearly, 0 debug_log) (oe_feu_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v185_feudal_ios.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# O(1) zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration.
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_feu_ran_y ?= current_year.
oe_feu_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_feu_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_feu_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_feu_yearly_runs } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_feu_yearly_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_feu_yearly_runs add = 1 }
		}
		oe_feu_apply_subject_strain_relief = yes
		oe_feu_dispatch_yearly_events = yes
	}
}

# Lightweight multi-vassal diplomatic strain relief for historical swarm overlords
# (FRA 38, BOH 20, LNG/CHI/YUA/MNG 67 tusis, SE Asia Mandala, MAL/MOR/TUN, NOV).
# Uses mode = replace (never add_and_extend) so relief clears naturally once consolidated.
oe_feu_apply_subject_strain_relief = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { oe_feu_is_feudal_realm = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { num_subjects >= 15 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_feu_mod_strain_relief_major years = 3 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { num_subjects >= 6 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_feu_mod_strain_relief_minor years = 3 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}
